name: agy-game-studio
description: End-to-end 2D game development studio for Go and Ebitengine with live 60 FPS WASM Playtest Studio, 10-second DVR GIF bug annotation, Sound Studio procedural audio (.music & .sfx) synthesis, dual YM2612 FM / Apple CoreAudio engines, and multi-track mixing.
suggestedPrompts: Design and build a 2D arcade game in Go with Ebitengine and launch it in Playtest Studio
Open Playtest Studio to playtest my Ebitengine game and capture a 10s DVR GIF bug report
Open Sound Studio to compose chiptune BGM or design procedural sound effects with live waveform and spectrum analysis
Generate procedural 2D sprites, particle VFX, and a chiptune soundtrack for my game
